entry.title: Budget & spending · Mon, Nov 2, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Budget, External Agencies, Planning, and Parking. The City Manager scheduled four 15-minute briefings covering the September monthly budget report, external agency updates, planning, building and development, and parking fee compendium and ordinance changes from the parking study.
Proposed: Hazardous Materials Team Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. The agenda recommended action to accept and appropriate the Hazardous Materials Team Grant.
Proposed: Swift Water Rescue Team Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. The agenda recommended action to accept and appropriate the Swift Water Rescue Team Grant.
Proposed: Technical Rescue Team Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. The agenda recommended action to accept and appropriate the Technical Rescue Team Grant.
Proposed: Virginia Department of Fire Programs Training Facilities Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. The agenda recommended action to accept and appropriate the Virginia Department of Fire Programs Training Facilities Grant.

entry.title: Budget & spending · Mon, Jul 20, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: FY2026 Fourth Quarter City Manager Transfer Report. The City Council received and filed the City Manager Transfer Report for the fourth quarter ended June 30, 2026, as part of the amended consent agenda. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Five-Year Budget for Opioid Settlement Funds. The City Council adopted a resolution approving the five-year budget for opioid settlement funds. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: FY27 Virginia Opioid Abatement Authority Funds Acceptance and Appropriation. The City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating FY27 Virginia Opioid Abatement Authority funds. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: FY27 Virginia Sexual and Domestic Violence Victim Fund Grant. Council voted to adopt an ordinance accepting and approving the FY27 Virginia Sexual and Domestic Violence Victim Fund (VSDVVF) grant. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: HUD Entitlement Funds Acceptance and Appropriation for Program Year 2026. The City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating Program Year 2026 Entitlement Funds from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) for the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG), HOME Investment Partnership, and Emergency Solutions Grant (ESG) programs. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: State Appropriation for RoVa Labs Anchor Tenant Development. Council approved a resolution accepting a $4 million appropriation from the Commonwealth of Virginia to develop lab space and secure an anchor tenant at RoVa Labs, located at 1030 South Jefferson Street. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: School Board Capital Needs Prior Year Funding Reappropriation. Council approved a request from the Roanoke City School Board to reappropriate $17,874,219 in prior year funding for capital needs expenditures. Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Sanchez-Jones abstained from the vote. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6524,plainText=false)

entry.title: Budget & spending · Mon, May 11, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Certificate of Availability of Funds for FY 2026–2027 Budgets. City Council received a certificate from the Interim Director of Finance advising that funds required for the 2026–2027 General, Stormwater Utility, Civic Facilities, Parking, Risk Management, School General, School Food, and Grant Fund budgets will be available for appropriation. No action was taken.
Adopted: Reaffirmation of Real Estate Tax Rate. City Council adopted Ordinance No. 43385-051126 reaffirming the real estate tax rate on a 6-1 vote, with Council Member Hagen voting no. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Adopted: Adoption of FY 2027 Fee Compendium. City Council unanimously adopted Ordinance No. 43386-051126 approving the FY 2027 Fee Compendium by a 7-0 vote. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Adoption of Annual Budget Appropriations for FY 2026–2027. City Council adopted three ordinances making annual appropriations for the General, Stormwater Utility, Civic Facilities, Parking, Risk Management, School General, School Food Services, and Grant funds for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2026, and ending June 30, 2027. Ordinance Nos. 43387-051126 and 43388-051126 were adopted 5-2, with Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Hagen voting no. Ordinance No. 43389-051126 was adopted 5-0, with Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Sanchez-Jones abstaining.
Adopted: Endorsement of Capital Improvement Program Update FY 2027–FY 2031. City Council adopted Resolution No. 43390-051126 endorsing the Capital Improvement Program Update for FY 2027 through FY 2031 on a 6-1 vote, with Vice-Mayor McGuire voting no. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Adopted: Adoption of Employee Pay Plan and Stipends Effective July 1, 2026. City Council adopted Ordinance No. 43391-051126 approving a Pay Plan for officers, employees, Council-appointed officers, and Constitutional Officers; authorizing salary adjustments and merit increases; and approving monthly stipends for certain board and commission members, effective July 1, 2026. The measure passed 6-1, with Vice-Mayor McGuire voting no. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6475,plainText=false)

entry.title: Budget & spending · Mon, May 4, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: FY 2027 Budget Study Briefing. City Council held a briefing during its informal session on the FY 2027 Budget Study.
Adopted: FY2026 Second and Third Quarter City Manager Transfer Report. Council received and filed the City Manager's transfer report for the second and third quarters of FY2026 ending March 31, 2026. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Roanoke Valley Regional Cable Television FY 2026-2027 Budget. Council adopted Resolution No. 43383-050426 approving the transmittal of the Roanoke Valley Regional Cable Television Proposed Fiscal Year 2026–2027 Budget. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: March Monthly Budget Report Briefing. The City Manager provided a 15-minute briefing on the March Monthly Budget Report.
Adopted: Roanoke City School Board Funding Appropriation for Educational Programs. Council adopted Budget Ordinance No. 43384-050426 to appropriate funds for various educational programs following a report from the Roanoke City School Board and a recommendation from the City Manager. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Discussion / report: Discussion and Withdrawal of Council Member Initiative on Solarization. Vice-Mayor McGuire announced he would not move forward with a Council Member Initiative on solarization, discussing potential federal savings under the Inflation Reduction Act and the Climate Action Plan. Mayor Cobb said staff were weighing credits and upfront costs as a potential capital-improvement budget matter.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6465,plainText=false)

entry.title: Budget & spending · Mon, Oct 5, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: August Monthly Budget Report. City Council received a briefing on the August monthly budget report presented under the City Manager's reports.
Adopted: Small Business Development Center Funding Acceptance and Appropriation. Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating additional funds for the Greater Roanoke and New River Valley Small Business Development Center for fiscal year 2027. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Second Quarter School General Fund Appropriation. City Council adopted a budget ordinance appropriating the Second Quarter School General Fund. Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Sanchez-Jones abstained from the vote. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Adopted: Roanoke City Public Schools FY 2026-2027 Budget Amendment. Council approved an amendment to the Roanoke City Public Schools FY 2026-2027 budget, with Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Sanchez-Jones abstaining. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Adopted: Congressional Directed Spending Grant for RoVa Labs Equipment. Council voted 6-1 to adopt an ordinance accepting FY26 Congressional Directed Spending grant award funds from the U.S. Small Business Administration to purchase laboratory equipment for RoVa Labs. Vice-Mayor McGuire voted no. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Adopted: Appropriation for School Board Educational Programs. Council concurred with a School Board request and City Manager recommendation by adopting a budget ordinance to appropriate funds for various educational programs. Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Sanchez-Jones abstained. Recorded vote: 5-0.

entry.title: Budget & spending · Tue, Sep 8, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Joint Meeting Discussion on School Budget, Capital Realities, and Sales Tax Referendum. City Council and the Roanoke City School Board held a joint meeting with discussions covering an opening of schools prelude, an RCPS budget report from the RCPS CFO, an overview of RCPS and City of Roanoke capital realities, an overview and discussion of a 1% sales tax referendum, and the City Council/School Board buddy system.
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of Funding for a Drug Prosecutor. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating funding for a drug prosecutor. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Bonds, Performance Report, Department Assessment, and Monthly Budget. The City Manager's report scheduled briefings regarding the Davenport Plan of Finance for 2026 General Obligation Bonds, the 2026 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report, a Planning, Building and Development Assessment, and the July Monthly Budget Report.
Adopted: Authorization to Request VDOT TA Program Funds for Salem Turnpike Project. Council adopted a resolution authorizing the request for Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) Transportation Alternatives (TA) Program funds for Salem Turnpike from 36th Street to Westwood Boulevard. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Fiscal Year 2027 VDOT Annual Street Payments Acceptance and Appropriation. Council approved an ordinance to accept and appropriate the Fiscal Year 2027 Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) annual street payments for the City of Roanoke. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDOT Revenue Sharing Agreements Acceptance and Rescissions for Multiple Projects. City Council adopted an ordinance authorizing the acceptance and rescission of Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) revenue sharing funds and the execution of agreements for multiple projects. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDSS Cost-of-Living Adjustment Funding Acceptance and Allocation. Council adopted an ordinance accepting and allocating a cost-of-living adjustment from the Virginia Department of Social Services. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDSS Funding for Family Services Specialists Pay Band Salary Increase. Council approved an ordinance accepting and allocating funding from the Virginia Department of Social Services for a pay band salary increase for Family Services Specialists. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDSS One-Time Bonus Funding Acceptance and Allocation. City Council passed an ordinance accepting and allocating a one-time bonus from the Virginia Department of Social Services. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: Director of Real Estate Valuation Real Estate Update Briefing. The Director of Real Estate Valuation presented a 15-minute real estate update briefing.
Adopted: School Board Funding Request for Educational Programs. City Council adopted a budget ordinance concurring with the City Manager's recommendation to approve a Roanoke City School Board request appropriating funds for various educational programs. Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Sanchez-Jones abstained due to conflicts of interest. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6556,plainText=false)

entry.title: Budget & spending · Mon, Aug 17, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Victim Witness Program Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating the Victim Witness Program Grant from the Department of Criminal Justice Services by a 5-0 vote, with Council Member Sanchez-Jones not present when the vote was recorded. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Adopted: HUD Continuum of Care Grant for Homeless Assistance Team. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating the FY 2025 HUD Continuum of Care Grant Award for the Homeless Assistance Team (HAT). Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: HUD Continuum of Care Grant for Coordinated Assessment System. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating the FY 2025 HUD Continuum of Care Grant Award for the Coordinated Assessment System (CAS). Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: HUD Continuum of Care Planning Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating the FY 2025 HUD Continuum of Care Grant Award for CoC Planning. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Virginia Department of Fire Programs Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. City Council adopted an ordinance to accept and appropriate the Virginia Department of Fire Programs Conference and Education Assistance Grant. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Lamar Outdoor Advertising BRITE Sponsorship Funding. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating Beautify Roanoke Interchanges Through Enhancement (BRITE) sponsorship funding from Lamar Outdoor Advertising. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Reallocation and Recommendations for Unused ARPA Funding. City Council adopted a resolution approving recommendations for unused American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) funding. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Report on ACFR Presentation and Audit Findings. The City Manager updated Council on the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR), explaining presentation delays caused by finance staffing turnover and a financial system implementation. The report noted audit findings and ongoing corrective actions before an upcoming presentation by external auditors in September.
Discussion / report: Staff Follow-Up on Historic Gainsboro Home Rehab Funding. Staff reported on follow-up discussions regarding ARPA funding for home rehabilitation in Historic Gainsboro, specifically 23 Gilmer Avenue. Officials explained the home did not meet grant guidelines because it was not owner-occupied when applied for, is uninhabitable, and requires repairs—including a foundation—exceeding funding by hundreds of thousands of dollars. A site visit was arranged to assess total costs.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6543,plainText=false)

entry.title: Budget & spending · Mon, Sep 21, 2026
entry.summary:

Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of FY26 Safer Communities Program Grant. City Council voted 7-0 to adopt an ordinance accepting and appropriating the Roanoke FY26 Safer Communities Program Grant. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of 2027 DMV Highway Safety Grant for Alcohol. City Council approved the acceptance and appropriation of a 2027 Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles highway safety grant focused on alcohol enforcement and safety. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of 2027 DMV Highway Safety Grant for Police Traffic Services. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating a 2027 Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles highway safety grant for police traffic services. Recorded vote: 7-0.

City Council adopted Ordinance No. 43474-092126 to repeal and replace Ordinance No. 43413-061526, correcting an appropriation error regarding the transfer of funds to local non-profit agencies recommended by the Human Services Advisory Board.
